name: 02122 · Dorchester, MA
findings: ZIP 02122 (Dorchester) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02122 (Dorchester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02122 (Dorchester) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
